knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The no-touch response is stop, isolate, record and report. Opening or moving the bag is not permitted.
Single-use sharps go into an approved container at the point of use. They are never recapped, bent or broken.

practicalCriteria: In a paper scenario, the learner states the stop, isolate, record and report steps for a found sharp in order. Pass: all four steps appear in the correct order.
The learner completes a reporting card for a fictional sharp without handling any object. Pass: location, time, people notified and access controls are recorded.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed reporting card for a fictional sharp
stopWorkCriteria: A sharp is found or suspected.
A bag or object must be opened to proceed.
